response.guide: Each entry is one company's report event within the window, sorted ascending by report date. The window spans days from start_date (positive = forward, negative = look-back). Distinguish "upcoming" from "already reported" by eps.actual: null means not yet reported. When report.verified is false, present the date as tentative rather than confirmed. An empty results array means no reports fall in the window (with filter=high_market_cap, no high-market-cap names do) — not an error. This tool does NOT return an "expected move" — pair with options data for implied-volatility-based moves.
